claims: The requested orthant calibration gives E>=S^2/(2*2^n)-a^(-n)S/2 and S<=2^(n+1)tau+2^n a^(-n).
The cap excludes the all-positive orthant after reflection, improving its count to d=2^n-1; the last-index argument also gives S<=d*tau+d*a^(-n).
No coefficient kappa>1/(2d) with the same exact diagonal or a^(-n)S/2 correction can hold uniformly, even for true feasible selector families.
An explicit family sequence keeps S=d/L^n>0 as a=Lm grows and exactly saturates E=S^2/(2d)-a^(-n)S/2.
The resulting coarse calibration mechanisms are not competitive with the existing R001 bound.
